title: Bug 650137: [29.x] Expense Locations and Per-diem rules in configuration - Backport
summary: Backport to 29.x that adds more expense locations and per-diem rules to the Expense Agent's default and demo data. Three new setup codeunits create the default expense locations, rule headers and rule conditions.
key_points: New setup codeunits Create Expense Locations, Create Expense Rule Headers and Create Expense Rule Conditions
Demo data codeunits for locations, rules and categories were reworked to use the new defaults
Small changes to the Expense Agent Setup page, the setup wizard, the rule tables and permission sets
quote: More expense locations and rules added to demo/default data.
